note: Recorded before the source cleanup; numerical trial fields are copied unchanged. Local paths, logs, build manifests, and per-sample traces are omitted.

metadata.policy: Williams order for four builds; alternating order for two builds. Every build occupies each position equally over a complete order cycle. One fresh server at a time. Require three quiet seconds before each run. Repeat a whole matched block for compiler overlap or more than 125% of one CPU core of unrelated work averaged across any measurement. Retain all attempts. Never retry delivery or server failures. At most three new attempts per block per invocation.
metadata.background_estimator: Host user+nice+system+steal CPU minus server, client and controller. IRQ/softirq excluded during traffic because benchmark network activity can cause them.

blocks.excluded_reason: Compiler overlap or excess background CPU; replace whole matched block
